description: Compare what a trip costs at every New Orleans airport (MSY) parking lot against a taxi or the bus both ways, for a given trip length and number of people. Uses the airport's own posted rates. Use for questions like 'cheapest parking at MSY for 4 days' or 'should I park or take a cab to the New Orleans airport'.

days.description: How long the car stays, in days (e.g. 3.5). Use 0.5 for a 12-hour trip.
